name: Axonaut
description: Axonaut — French all-in-one CRM, invoicing and expense management for very small businesses: companies, employees, invoices, quotations, expenses, products and projects. REST API v2, API-key auth.
instructions:
**Getting a key**
1. Sign in to Axonaut and open **Paramètres → API** (Settings → API).
2. Copy the key into `AXONAUT_API_KEY`. It is account-wide and carries full access; treat it as a password.

**The header is `userApiKey`.** Not `Authorization`, not `X-API-Key` — Axonaut's own spelling, camel-cased, is what the server checks.

**Axonaut calls customers 'companies' and people 'employees'.** A `company` is a client or prospect organisation; an `employee` is a person attached to one. This trips people up, because 'employee' sounds like your own staff and is not.

**Paging is `page`, 1-based, fixed at 100 rows.** There is no page-size parameter. The response carries the total in the `X-Total-Count` header, so you can tell when to stop.

**Dates are `DD/MM/YYYY`** on most filters — French format, not ISO. This is the single most common source of a filter that silently matches nothing.

**Amounts are floats in euros**, pre-tax (`preTaxAmount`) and inclusive (`totalAmount`) side by side.

**Unverified.** The paths and field names below follow the vendor's published documentation and have not been exercised against a live tenant. Treat a 404 as a docs-versus-reality gap and check the developer portal before concluding that the credential is wrong. A correction from anyone running this against a real system is genuinely welcome.

**Cloud reachability**: axonaut.com is public with a valid certificate.

tools.name: axonaut_list_companies
tools.description: List companies — Axonaut's clients and prospects — with their name, SIRET, address, category and assigned user. 100 rows per page, no page size.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pages are fixed at 100 rows.

tools.name: axonaut_get_company
tools.description: Read one company in full: its addresses, custom fields, the employees attached to it and its accounting identifiers.

tools.name: axonaut_list_employees
tools.description: List employees — the *people* attached to client companies, not your own staff — with their name, e-mail, phone and role.

tools.name: axonaut_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with their number, date, company, pre-tax and total amounts and payment state. Dates in the filters are DD/MM/YYYY, not ISO.

date_before.description: Latest invoice date, DD/MM/YYYY — French format, not ISO.

date_after.description: Earliest invoice date, DD/MM/YYYY — French format, not ISO.

tools.name: axonaut_get_invoice
tools.description: Read one invoice in full: every product line with quantity, price and VAT, the totals, and the payments recorded against it.

tools.name: axonaut_list_quotations
tools.description: List quotations (devis) with their number, date, company, total and whether they have been accepted.

tools.name: axonaut_list_expenses
tools.description: List expenses and supplier invoices with their date, supplier, category, pre-tax amount and VAT — the cost side of the ledger.

tools.name: axonaut_list_products
tools.description: List catalogue products with their reference, name, pre-tax price, VAT rate and stock quantity.

tools.name: axonaut_list_projects
tools.description: List projects with their name, company, budget, status and dates — the anchor for time and profitability questions.
